labels.notes: git diff HEAD of Admissible.lean: the statements of GX.BTZAdm.e0RegM_linearPart_faithful_discrete and GX.BTZAdm.btzprop_holonomy_e0 are byte-identical to HEAD. The only changes are the new import, the proof that replaces the sorry, its docstring, the module-docstring bullet, the checklist row and SCOPE (a). No other declaration's statement changed. The proof gets its inputs from the existing hypotheses (hGH, hCC, hmax, hnm, hpair). It goes through the strict E0AbsMax.cor_abs_max_C1 (Reg M GH and Cauchy-complete), the strict e0RegM_holonomy (loxodromic, rho injective, torsion-free), Causal.Flat.exists_developsCC_of_isCauchyComplete' with ccAction_of_developsCC (CCAction data), and not_isMetabelianOn_range (from hnm and injectivity). No new hypothesis was added to the exported theorem. The group-level lemmas in AdmissibleLinear.lean (CCAction, loxodromic, not metabelian, torsion-free) are fully discharged at the holonomy level. The row stays partial and unmarked for disclosed reasons: E0 only (T-btz-scope), the marking mu taken as a hypothesis (T-btz-headline-repr), and 'anabelian' read as 'pi_1(Reg M) not metabelian', which was already the reading before this target. The module docstring writes the label without the bold mark and says 'partial, unmarked'. AdmissibleLinear.lean marks no label. Paper l.1149 (Barbot: rho_L discrete and faithful) is matched in substance: injectivity of linearPart.comp rho and DiscreteTopology of its range in lorentz 2.
